title: The Leech
note: Written from _fit_report.json of the same run - the numbers are the harness's, not retyped. The game build uses `ratio` and `creature_h`; do not re-derive scale.

leech.span_note: MEASURED, NOT DERIVED - asked for by the game build's S58 row (05:58 CT 20 Nov): bestiary.gd:127-128 carries no `span` key, so the leech was exempt from the corridor check entirely. Same instrument as the variants' span_x: lordgen.world_bounds off the evaluated depsgraph, leech.glb scaled so z-height == the shipped creature_h 2.32. The glb already ships at that height (native 2.32, scale_k 1.0), which is an independent check on creature_h. 4 meshes, 4168 verts. Script: tools/art/_leech_span.py.
leech.span_set_by: THE PROPS, NOT THE BODY. Per-mesh: leech_bone span_x 2.2581 (the basin rim, its tripod and the pale tool), leech_dark 2.0854, leech_body 1.706, leech_glow 1.4595. The corridor term is 0.552 m wider than the creature itself - a gate that measured the body alone would under-report it. Confirmed by eye in hero_side.png: the basin stands proud of the body.
